layers.note: Forms patches on rich, moist ground: stream banks, flood plains and alder stands.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 1,500 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

max_slope_deg.note: Grows on flats and gentle slopes.

shade_tolerance.note: Grows in sun or part shade.
